test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

We should teach our wards not to __look down upon__ anybody in human society.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Despise somebody****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"look down upon"** means to regard someone with a feeling of superiority or contempt. (नफरत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She tends to **look down upon** people who are less educated than her.
 
 
 
• **"Despise somebody" **refers to feeling a strong dislike or having contempt for someone. (किसी से घृणा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He **despises anyone** who lies or cheats.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Talk leniently **(नरमी से बात करना): To speak in a soft or forgiving manner.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher decided to **talk leniently** to the student who made a mistake.
 
 
 
• **Kneel down **(घुटने टेकना): To lower oneself by bending the knees.
 
 
• **Example: **He had to **kneel down** to propose to his girlfriend.
 
 
 
• **Guess on something** (किसी चीज़ का अनुमान लगाना): To make a prediction or estimate without sufficient information.
 
 
• **Example:** He had to **guess on the final question** of the quiz.
 
 

17c:T9dd,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
